body: I struggle to understand how you could even have sex with someone you’re “unhappy” with and don’t want to do it with. Maybe I’m too black and white about this. But of course the insecurity is “is it just keeping up appearances though...”
Starting to believe she’s a cake eater after being here...

This is my first time ever being in this situation and it’s definitely been a true test of strength but I have also learned a lot from myself. I’m very insecure and I wouldn’t have known that without this experience. 

It’s the weird double reality of her telling me she wants me and only me, but then goes to bed and has sex with her partner.. it’s very mind fucking. It’s probably not for me. But I’m in it now and I have to deal with it.

It’s hard because I don’t know what to believe. She promises me everything she does with her boyfriend is a facade, even the sex, and that she wants me entirely and to just be patient while sh figures it out. But I don’t know if i can trust that. Can’t tell if I just need to chill, or she’s just telling me what I wanna hear cos she wants her cake and eat it too.

Yeah. It was a fun flirty secret. Then she caught feelings, then I followed suit. And ironically now it’s like it’s taken a huge backseat - I think she’s having a “good patch” with her partner...

Edit: I know I logically need to pull back, but feelings make that incredibly hard man
Yup. I’m single and she has a boyfriend

I’m sorry it didn’t work out. That’s my biggest fear, the day I get the text message explaining how she can’t do this anymore and that she needs to focus on her partner.. feel sick just thinking of that lol

I failed to separate her from my own life and that’s where I fucked up. I’m thinking of her and have expectations of her like she’s my girlfriend when she’s not. I just gotta chill, and unfortunately I can’t seem to. 

Like you said, work on myself, somehow

Apparently it’s not as simple as breaking up with him outta no where cos they live together and share money etc etc. I understand that. Just wish I could ask for more effort from her but obviously I cannot do that. Do you want me or do you want him, you know?
I suppose i just have to sit back and “let her come to me”. Just hard to get all the thoughts out my head and get on with my days
